app.title: Interest Calculator
app.tagline: Simple interest between two dates — clear, fast and private.

form.heading: Enter details
form.principalHelp: The original amount of money on which interest is calculated.
form.rateHelp: Enter a monthly or yearly simple interest rate. Yearly rates are divided by 12 for monthly calculations.
form.fromHelp: The date from which interest begins.
form.toHelp: The date until which interest is calculated. Defaults to today.
form.currencyNote: Currency only changes how amounts are displayed. Nothing is converted.

errors.principalInvalid: Principal must be a valid number (digits and a decimal point only).
errors.principalPositive: Principal must be greater than zero.
errors.principalTooLarge: Principal is too large. Please enter a smaller amount.
errors.rateInvalid: Interest rate must be a valid number.
errors.ratePeriodInvalid: Please select monthly or yearly for the interest rate.
errors.fromInvalid: Please select a valid start date.
errors.toInvalid: Please select a valid end date.
errors.toBeforeFrom: End date cannot be earlier than the start date.

results.title: Results
results.empty: Enter the details above and press “Calculate Interest” to see your results.
results.monthlyHelp: Interest for one full calendar month, using the selected rate (yearly rates are divided by 12).
results.formulaGeneric: Monthly interest = Principal × Monthly rate ÷ 100. For a partial month, multiply by days in the period ÷ days in that calendar month.
results.zeroDays: The start and end dates are the same (0 days), so the interest is zero.
results.monthlyCalculationNote: Interest is calculated month by month using calendar-month lengths. Partial months are prorated, and interest does not compound.
results.notBinding: This is an estimate, not a legally binding settlement amount. It depends on the selected rate, dates and monthly calculation method.

ads.label: Advertisement
ads.advertiseDesc: Promote your business to our audience.

footer.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This calculator provides an estimate based on the selected inputs and calculation convention.
footer.privacy: Privacy: All calculations run in your browser. Your amounts and dates are never sent anywhere.
